title: दशमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 10 · Kripa and the others meet the royal procession

summary.en: A short way out, the women meet Kripa, Ashvatthaman and Kritavarman, who tell them what happened to Duryodhana and the night attack. The three fear the Pandavas' wrath and leave in different directions.
summary.kn: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯರು ಕೃಪ, ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ, ಕೃತವರ್ಮರನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅವರು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನಿಗೆ ಆದದ್ದನ್ನು, ರಾತ್ರಿ ದಾಳಿಯನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಮೂವರು ಪಾಂಡವರ ಕೋಪಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆದರಿ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: थोड़ी दूर पर स्त्रियाँ कृप, अश्वत्थामा और कृतवर्मा से मिलती हैं, जो दुर्योधन के साथ और रात के आक्रमण का हाल बताते हैं। तीनों पाण्डवों के क्रोध से डरकर अलग-अलग दिशाओं में चले जाते हैं।
summary.te: కొంత దూరంలో స్త్రీలు కృపుడు, అశ్వత్థామ, కృతవర్మలను కలుస్తారు; వారు దుర్యోధనునికి జరిగినది, రాత్రి దాడి గురించి చెబుతారు. ముగ్గురు పాండవుల కోపానికి భయపడి వేర్వేరు దిశల్లో వెళ్లిపోతారు.
summary.ta: சற்றுத் தொலைவில் பெண்கள் கிருபர், அஸ்வத்தாமன், கிருதவர்மனைச் சந்திக்க, அவர்கள் துரியோதனனுக்கு நடந்ததையும் இரவுத் தாக்குதலையும் கூறுகின்றனர். மூவரும் பாண்டவரின் சினத்துக்கு அஞ்சி வெவ்வேறு திசைகளில் செல்கின்றனர்.
summary.ml: പുറത്തേക്ക് കുറച്ചുദൂരം പോയപ്പോൾ സ്ത്രീകൾ കൃപർ, അശ്വത്ഥാമാവ്, കൃതവർമ്മാവ് എന്നിവരെ കാണുന്നു; ദുര്യോധനന് സംഭവിച്ചതും രാത്രിയിലെ ആക്രമണവും അവർ പറയുന്നു. പാണ്ഡവരുടെ കോപത്തെ ഭയന്ന് മൂവരും വ്യത്യസ്ത ദിശകളിലേക്ക് പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 11.10; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 17 2017

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
क्रोशमात्रं ततो गत्वा ददृशुस्तान्महारथान् ।
शारद्वतं कृपं द्रौणिं कृतवर्माणमेव च ॥

meaning.en: After going a krosha, they saw the great charioteers Kripa son of Sharadvat, Drona's son Ashvatthaman, and Kritavarman.

verses.text:
ते तु दृष्ट्वैव राजानं प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमीश्वरम् ।
अश्रुकण्ठा विनिःश्वस्य रुदन्तमिदमब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: The moment they saw the king, the lord with the eye of wisdom, they sighed with tears in their throats and spoke to him as he wept.

verses.text:
पुत्रस्तव महाराज कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् ।
गतः सानुचरो राजञ्शक्रलोकं महीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: Great king, your son the lord of the earth has gone with his followers to Indra's world, having done a most difficult deed.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनबलान्मुक्ता वयमेव त्रयो रथाः ।
सर्वमन्यत्परिक्षीणं सैन्यं ते भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Of Duryodhana's host only we three charioteers are left, bull of the Bharatas. All the rest of your army is destroyed.

verses.text:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानं कृपः शारद्वतस्तदा ।
गान्धारीं पुत्रशोकार्तामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Having said this to the king, Kripa son of Sharadvat then spoke to Gandhari, who was afflicted with grief for her sons.

verses.text:
अभीता युध्यमानास्ते घ्नन्तः शत्रुगणान्बहून् ।
वीरकर्माणि कुर्वाणाः पुत्रास्ते निधनं गताः ॥

meaning.en: Fearless, fighting, slaying many bands of enemies and performing heroic deeds, your sons met their end.

verses.text:
ध्रुवं संप्राप्य लोकांस्ते निर्मलाञ्शस्त्रनिर्जितान् ।
भास्वरं देहमास्थाय विहरन्त्यमरा इव ॥

meaning.en: Surely they have reached spotless worlds won by weapons and, taking radiant bodies, they sport like immortals.

verses.text:
न हि कश्चिद्धि शूराणां युध्यमानः पराङ्मुखः ।
शस्त्रेण निधनं प्राप्तो न च कश्चित्कृताञ्जलिः ॥

meaning.en: No hero fighting turned his back, no one died by a weapon with joined palms in surrender.

verses.text:
एतां तां क्षत्रियस्याहुः पुराणां परमां गतिम् ।
शस्त्रेण निधनं संख्ये तान्न शोचितुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: The ancients call this the highest goal of a kshatriya: death in battle by the weapon. You should not grieve for them.

verses.text:
न चापि शत्रवस्तेषामृध्यन्ते राज्ञि पाण्डवाः ।
शृणु यत्कृतमस्माभिरश्वत्थामपुरोगमैः ॥

meaning.en: And their enemies, the Pandavas, do not prosper, queen. Hear what we did, led by Ashvatthaman.

verses.text:
अधर्मेण हतं श्रुत्वा भीमसेनेन ते सुतम् ।
सुप्तं शिबिरमाविश्य पाण्डूनां कदनं कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that your son was struck down unfairly by Bhimasena, we entered the camp while the Pandavas slept and made a slaughter.

verses.text:
पाञ्चाला निहताः सर्वे धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः ।
द्रुपदस्यात्मजाश्चैव द्रौपदेयाश्च पातिताः ॥

meaning.en: All the Panchalas led by Dhrishtadyumna were killed, and Drupada's sons and the sons of Draupadi were felled.

verses.text:
तथा विशसनं कृत्वा पुत्रशत्रुगणस्य ते ।
प्राद्रवाम रणे स्थातुं न हि शक्यामहे त्रयः ॥

meaning.en: Having thus slaughtered the host of enemies of your son, we fled, for we three cannot stand in battle.

verses.text:
ते हि शूरा महेष्वासाः क्षिप्रमेष्यन्ति पाण्डवाः ।
अमर्षवशमापन्ना वैरं प्रतिजिहीर्षवः ॥

meaning.en: Those heroic great archers, the Pandavas, will come quickly, possessed by wrath and wanting to repay the enmity.

verses.text:
निहतानात्मजाञ्श्रुत्वा प्रमत्तान्पुरुषर्षभाः ।
निनीषन्तः पदं शूराः क्षिप्रमेव यशस्विनि ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that their sons had been killed in negligence, those bull-like heroes, glorious queen, will come to track us down quickly.

verses.text:
पाण्डूनां किल्बिषं कृत्वा संस्थातुं नोत्सहामहे ।
अनुजानीहि नो राज्ञि मा च शोके मनः कृथाः ॥

meaning.en: Having wronged the Pandavas, we have no courage to stay. Give us leave, queen, and do not set your mind on grief.

verses.text:
राजंस्त्वमनुजानीहि धैर्यमातिष्ठ चोत्तमम् ।
निष्ठान्तं पश्य चापि त्वं क्षत्रधर्मं च केवलम् ॥

meaning.en: King, give us leave and take up the highest steadiness. See that the end has come, and that kshatriya dharma alone remains.

verses.text:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानं कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम् ।
कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च द्रोणपुत्रश्च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Having spoken thus to the king and circled him with respect, Kripa, Kritavarman and Drona's son,

verses.text:
अवेक्षमाणा राजानं धृतराष्ट्रं मनीषिणम् ।
गङ्गामनु महात्मानस्तूर्णमश्वानचोदयन् ॥

meaning.en: looking back at the wise King Dhritarashtra, great-souled, quickly drove their horses along the Ganga.

verses.text:
अपक्रम्य तु ते राजन्सर्व एव महारथाः ।
आमन्त्र्यान्योन्यमुद्विग्नास्त्रिधा ते प्रययुस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Going away, king, all those great charioteers, distressed, took leave of one another and went off in three directions.

verses.text:
जगाम हास्तिनपुरं कृपः शारद्वतस्तदा ।
स्वमेव राष्ट्रं हार्दिक्यो द्रौणिर्व्यासाश्रमं ययौ ॥

meaning.en: Kripa son of Sharadvat went to Hastinapura, Kritavarman, son of Hridika, to his own kingdom, and Drona's son to Vyasa's hermitage.

verses.text:
एवं ते प्रययुर्वीरा वीक्षमाणाः परस्परम् ।
भयार्ताः पाण्डुपुत्राणामागस्कृत्वा महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: So those heroes went, looking at one another, in fear of the great-souled sons of Pandu, whom they had wronged.

verses.text:
समेत्य वीरा राजानं तदा त्वनुदिते रवौ ।
विप्रजग्मुर्महाराज यथेच्छकमरिंदमाः ॥

meaning.en: Having met the king, those heroes, tamers of foes, parted as they wished, great king, when the sun had not yet risen.
